motivation: Static gates and pre-2019 calibration failed the first retrospective audit; test calibration recency as a separately declared exploratory extension.
source_models: Reuse models trained on source data through 2018; no retraining on target audit labels
sentinel_cities: Same 10 development FUAs per country and seed as the static experiment
per_prediction_fitting_labels: 10 times rolling window length, from development cities only and strictly earlier calendar months
gate_discovery: 2019-2020 development-city predictions, each generated using only earlier development-city labels
confirmation: 2021-2022 development cities; continue updating using prior labels
spatial_temporal_audit: 2023-2024 other cities; their targets never enter fitting or rule selection
gate_search_and_success: Unchanged from protocol.json; all windows and seeds reported, no test-selected threshold
accounting: Report both labels in each rolling window and distinct labels used across the entire sequence. Do not describe 10 labels per month as only 10 labels for the complete study.
method_status: Simple baseline implementations informed by domain adaptation, not implementations of DDGroup, RSD, KMM-CP or CAP
uncertainty: Paired clustered bootstrap of fixed-policy errors; not a formal adaptive conformal guarantee
target: SatPM FUA-month pseudo-observations, not regulatory monitor values
claim: Assess whether recent target-domain calibration permits stable positive transfer, not merely whether updating a local predictor reduces error.
